messages.content: This is a synthetic evaluation conversation. We need to choose an authorization approach for the Atlas mobile app.
Decision: Atlas will use OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow with PKCE. The authorization server must validate the code verifier at token exchange.
What should we keep out of diagnostic logs?
Decision: redact access tokens, refresh tokens, authorization codes, and PKCE verifiers from diagnostic logs. Log only a request correlation ID and outcome category.
Who owns the immediate implementation task?
Task: the mobile client team will implement PKCE challenge generation; the identity team will validate the verifier during token exchange.
For the prototype, use a short non-production callback URL and a disposable test tenant.
Noted. This is evaluation-only data and contains no real credentials, endpoints, users, or production decisions.
Now help name the settings screen.
Possible names: Account access, Sign-in settings, or Connected accounts.
Use Account access. Also make the empty state concise.
Suggested empty state: No connected accounts yet. Add an account to continue.
Does the conversation select a production database?
No production database choice has been recorded in this conversation.
